caseNameFull: Kolvaleski, Administrator v. Pennsylvania Railroad Co.
attorneys: Mr. E. Burke Finnerty for petitioner. -Mr. John A. Hartpence for respondent.
judges: Are, Black, Granted, Should, That, Writ

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit- denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that the petition for writ of certiorari should be granted.
